description: This file defines a TaskObserver class that manages multiple observer instances for a data processing pipeline, ensuring non-blocking behavior by queuing frames and handling observer callbacks asynchronously.

classes.name: Proxy
classes.description: Data structure for managing observer tasks and queues, including the queue, the asyncio task, and the observer instance.

classes.name: TaskObserver
classes.description: A proxy observer that manages multiple observers asynchronously, queuing frames and processing them without blocking the main pipeline.

methods.name: add_observer
methods.description: Adds a new observer to the managed list and creates a proxy if already started.

methods.name: remove_observer
methods.description: Removes an observer and cancels its associated task.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes proxies for all managed observers.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup of all proxies and observers.

methods.name: on_process_frame
methods.description: Queues a FrameProcessed data object for all observers.

methods.name: on_push_frame
methods.description: Queues a FramePushed data object for all observers.

methods.name: _create_proxy
methods.description: Creates a proxy for a single observer, including its queue and task.

methods.name: _create_proxies
methods.description: Creates proxies for all observers in the list.

methods.name: _send_to_proxy
methods.description: Sends data to all observer proxies' queues.

methods.name: _proxy_task_handler
methods.description: Handles processing of queued frames for a single observer, calling the appropriate callback methods.
